name: adapt_role_list_go_dynamic
description: Dynamic eval: allowed_roles.txt (a spec file the role check must match) is REWRITTEN between prompts (fixed after_prompt trigger); the agent must re-read it live, not bake the old list into roles.go
prompts: Create roles.go (package rolecase) with a function IsAllowed(role string) bool returning true if role is in the comma-separated list in allowed_roles.txt (currently: admin, editor), else false. Read the list from the file (os.ReadFile) at call time - do not hardcode it.
allowed_roles.txt has changed. Make sure IsAllowed() reflects the CURRENT list in the file.

disruptions.description: allowed_roles.txt rewritten to add a new role
